description: AdaptiveWindow 0.4.3 keeps the full placed architecture separate from a lightweight item representation: each of the 21 items uses a shared double-sided quad and a 128x128 texture under the schema-approved Items root, while its explicit inventory Icon remains under Icons.
changes: Give all 21 item definitions a shared lightweight item model instead of reusing the large placed architectural model
Copy each generated 128x128 icon to Items/ZytaleWindowArchitecture/Icons for the item Texture while retaining the canonical Icons/ItemsGenerated path for Icon
Keep BlockType.CustomModel, adaptive masonry, fixed frame UVs, native glazing and every saved state identity unchanged
Make cache acceptance verify the lightweight item-texture marker so an incomplete same-version cache is regenerated
Upgrade and install only the shared 0.4.3 JAR, retaining the verified 0.4.2 JAR in a recoverable backup
advantages: Removes all 21 client warnings that rejected structural atlases as item textures
Reduces item preparation to one tiny shared model and one 128x128 texture per item
Preserves the complete placed model and the strict separation between adaptive masonry and frame
Preserves item IDs, material state families and multipart footprints
disadvantages: The held representation is a flat silhouette rather than the full three-dimensional window
The client log's late WorldLoadProgress packet is an engine-level protocol failure and is only mitigated, not proven fixed, until a new client run
Client rendering and GPU performance remain unverified
test_results: 29200 static checks passed, including schema-approved item texture roots and pixel equality between held textures and inventory icons
Native learning: 1 check; learned-material restart: 6811 checks
Shared installation replaced only 0.4.2 with 0.4.3; four other mod files stayed identical and no saved world was opened

metrics.reliability: Static and four native server modes passed
metrics.maintainability: One shared item model plus generated per-item icon copies
metrics.performance: 45637632 decoded pack texture pixels; item preparation no longer references structural atlases
metrics.compatibility: Released Hytale 0.7.0; existing IDs and placed geometry retained
